# About me {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Veterinarian and One Health epidemiologist working on neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) and zoonoses in Malawi since 2020. Research interests centre on surveillance sensitivity, spatial transmission dynamics and the targeting of control and elimination interventions. Current work examines canine rabies persistence and surveillance gaps, with further research experience in schistosomiasis and trypanosomiasis. Experience spans clinical veterinary practice, NTD awareness, community-based surveillance design, spatial analysis in R and GIS, and linkage of fragmented human and animal health records, with government, NGO and academic partners.

**Let's connect and collaborate.** I welcome collaborations in One Health, infectious disease epidemiology and surveillance, particularly work that strengthens health systems in resource-limited settings.
